info.name: Planview AgilePlace API (LeanKit) v2 account tags API

description.content:
RESTful API for Planview AgilePlace (formerly LeanKit) Kanban boards, cards, lanes, connections, automations, teams, and planning increments. All requests use HTTPS against https://<yourhostname>.leankit.com/io/. Data is sent and received as JSON. Transcribed from the published Planview AgilePlace API reference — no endpoints invented.
